title: Sponza with cloth drapes
description: Sponza at midday with its ten arcade curtains (hung from their top corners, so they sag into swags) and eight balcony banners replaced by simulated cloth in the model's own fabrics, stirred by a gusty breeze through the atrium. The architecture collides with the cloth.
